senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. מָהָה) to rub, wipe out; to wear out, destroy. [In Talm. mostly מָחַק.] Erub. 13ᵃ; Sot. II, 4 (17ᵇ) (ref. to ומחה, Num. V, 23) כתב שיכול לִמְחוֹת (Mish. להִמָּחֵק) a writing which one can wash off.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23:2">Gen. R. s. 23</cite> (play on <he>מחויאל</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 4:18">Gen. IV, 18</cite>) <he>מוֹחָן אני וכ׳</he> I shall wipe them out of the world; a. e.—V. <cite ref="M00823"><he>מָחוּי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 38b:5">B. Bath. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>מי׳ בפני שנים</he> if he entered a protest against the illegitimate occupation of his property in the presence of two (v. <cite ref="M00793"><he>מְחָאָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 38b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>וכי למָחוֹת וכ׳</he> must he protest in the occupant’s presence?—
<cite ref="Ketubot 11a:12">Keth. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>מִיחֲתָה</he> she protested against her conversion in childhood.
<cite ref="Pesachim 88a:11">Pes. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>יכולה למחות</he> she has the privilege of protesting (declaring her preference); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (with ב or ביד of the person) to forewarn, interfere, try to prevent.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 55b:19">Sabb. 55ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מפני שהיה לו … בחפני ולא מי׳</he> (not <he>לחפני</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) it was for Ph. to forewarn Hofni, and he did not.
<cite ref="Shabbat 55a:8">Ib.ᵃ</cite> <he>שאם מִיחוּ בהם לא יקבלו מהם</he> (Ms. M. <he>מחו … קבלו</he>) that if they warned them, they would not have heeded them.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 4:8">Pes. IV, 8</cite>, a. e. <he>לא מיחו בידם</he> they did not prohibit their doing so; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:12">Cant. R. to IV, 12</cite> <he>עמדו הבנות</he> (<cite ref="F00000"><he>ו</he></cite>)<he>מִיחוּ על עצמן וכ׳</he> the daughters (in their father’s absence) entered a protest concerning themselves and gave themselves away to husbands (Pesik. B’shall., p. 82ᵃ, a. e. <he>נתעסקו בעצמן</he>).

senses.gloss: to dissolve, dilute. Y. Pes. III, beg. 29ᵈ ה׳ את החמץ if (by boiling) he made a mush of the leavened matter (made it unrecognizable).
units: <cite ref="Chullin 120a">Ḥull. 120ᵃ</cite>; Y. Maas. Sh. II, beg. 53ᵇ, a. e., v. <cite ref="C00996"><he>גָּמָא</he></cite>; a. fr. (interchanging with <cite ref="M00346"><he>הִמְהָה</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 9:8">Tosef. Par. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 8:8">VIII</cite>), 8 <he>הִמְחָן באור</he> (not <he>באויר</he>) if he thawed the frozen water by artificial heat.—[<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 6:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. VI, 7</cite> <he>וממחה</he>, read <he>וממסה</he>, v. <cite ref="M01852"><he>מָסָה</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:10">B. Bath. V, 10</cite> <he>מַמְחֶה משקלותיו</he> cleanses his weights.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 7:4">Lev. R. s. 7</cite> (play on <he>מיחים</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 66:15">Ps. LXVI, 15</cite>) <he>כזה שהוא ממחה בקערה</he> like him who wipes a dish (licks the remnants up); Pesik. Eth Korb., p. 61ᵃ; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 16:1">Pesik. R. s. 16</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 17">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XVII</cite> <he>מַמְחָה בכפיה</he> she produces a sound by rubbing her hands (in sympathy with the mourners).

senses.gloss: (denom. of מוּמְחֶה) to recognize as an authority; in gen. to authorize; to appoint.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 23a:21-22">Snh. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>לא כל הימנו … שהִמְחוּהוּ רבים עליהם</he> he cannot reject a judge whom the majority has recognized as an authority over them.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:12">B. Mets. IX, 12</cite> <he>הִמְחֵהוּ אצל וכ׳</he> if he gave him an order to the storekeeper. Y. Pes. VIII, 35ᵈ top <he>אם במַמְחִין סתם האשה מַמְחָה וכ׳</he> if by <he>מדעתו</he> is meant giving authority (and not merely knowing and tolerating), it is tacitly understood that a woman makes an appointment as if saying, I will dine with my children; if it means merely knowing, then the Mishnah (<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 8:1">Pes. VIII, 1</cite>) means appointment.—[Y. Sabb. XIII, beg. 14ᵃ <he>הממחה צדדיו</he> ed. Krot., v. <cite ref="M03039"><he>מָתַח</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to be dissolved, washed away; to be wiped out, destroyed. Y. Pes. III, beg. 29ᵈ a cake boiled שלא נ׳ without being mashed beyond recognition (v. supra).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 3:8">Taan. III, 8</cite>, a. e. <he>אם נִמְחֵית וכ׳</he>, whether the stone … has been washed away, v. <cite ref="A00172"><he>אֶבֶן</he></cite>. Tosef. Par. l. c. <he>נִימּוֹחוּ</he> (fr. <cite ref="M00848"><he>מָחַח</he></cite>) the water was thawed up.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28">Gen. R. s. 28</cite>. <he>אפי׳ אסטרובולין … נ׳</he> even the millstone was washed away.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28">Ib.</cite> <he>וכמה נימוחו מהם</he> and how many of them were destroyed?; a. e.
